verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own pages claim it enables automated change approval processes, but only when paired with Jira Service Management, which is a separate product. Native support comes from enforceable change-management workflows, merge checks, and environment-level permissions that can gate deployments. All of this rests on marketing-level claims only. Missing for 10: native change approval without the separate Jira Service Management product, in-depth documentation of how approvals block production deployments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
